$comment: RFC 0193 §B — the seat for the v1 enum. v1 default-when-absent was `warn`; the v2 record keeps that default, so an advertised record with no `mode` means `warn` and not `unset`.

mode.description: Schema-version drift handling. `warn` (the default when this seat is absent, as in v1): an engine MUST attempt validation against the advertised version and log `envelope_schema_version_drift`. `strict`: the same condition MUST refuse with `unknown_schema_version`. Drift ABOVE the advertised floor refuses under both (`events.md` §"The envelope-kind catalog").
